remarks: Welcome to 262 Old Kings Highway South, a beautifully renovated farmhouse that perfectly blends classic charm with modern amenities. Nestled in a prime location, this stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers convenience, comfort, and style.   Enjoy a bright and airy open floor plan featuring hardwood floors, central air, and updated finishes throughout. The thoughtfully designed kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, sleek countertops, and ample storage-ideal for home chefs. The inviting living and dining areas are perfect for entertaining or relaxing.   Unwind in the serene screened porch, overlooking the private, beautifully landscaped backyard-a true retreat for outdoor enjoyment. Both bathrooms are elegantly updated, complementing the spacious bedrooms filled with natural light.   Situated in the highly sought-after Tokeneke School District, this home is less than 1 mile from both Darien train stations and the town centers, offering easy access to top-rated restaurants, shopping, and amenities. Just minutes from town beaches and Great Island Park, this location is perfect for those who appreciate convenience and coastal charm.  Available for an annual lease, with the option to rent furnished. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to enjoy modern luxury in one of Darien's most desirable locations!
